lazy.dialogue.chat/1: No rush, %1$s. Sit if you like. I've nowhere to be that won't keep.
lazy.dialogue.chat/2: Talk away. The work will still be there after, and it's never minded waiting.
lazy.dialogue.chat/3: Good timing — I was just slowing down. Say your piece, %1$s.
lazy.dialogue.conversations/1: A long talk? Even better. Those are best taken slowly, %1$s.
lazy.dialogue.conversations/2: Sure. Pull up something to sit on. No sense doing this standing.
lazy.dialogue.conversations/3: Happily. I do my best thinking at this speed anyway.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Comfortable, thanks. Everything got done eventually, and eventually was soon enough.
Easy week. Nothing urgent turned up, and I didn't go looking for any.
Can't complain. Warm afternoons, work that waited its turn. That's about ideal.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.roug: A bit much, honestly — too many things wanting doing at once. I've been unpicking it slowly. It's coming right.
Rough patch. Everything's been in a hurry except me. I'll outlast it, %1$s.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.agai: You asked already, %1$s. I move slower than the news does.
Same as before. Give it a few days and I might have something new.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Good one. Got the morning's work done by midday and spent the rest of it in the sun, unrepentant.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.day.good/2: Fine day. Nothing demanded anything of me twice. I call that a success.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Everything wanted doing at once today. I did it one at a time anyway. Took longer, but nothing got broken.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/2: Busy sort of day. I don't much care for busy — it makes people careless.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: I do. It's steady, and it doesn't shout at me. Done properly at my own pace, it's honest work.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.work.like/2: Well enough. I've never seen the point of rushing something you'll only have to redo.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: It's the pace I mind, not the work. Everyone wants everything yesterday. I've stopped competing.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.work.hate/2: It's fine, till someone stands over me hurrying it along. Then it isn't.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s does me nicely. Nobody here is in much of a hurry, and that's rarer than you'd think.
I like %2$s. Slow place, good shade, and the well's never far. What else is there?
lazy.dialogue.conversations.people.first: Good sorts, mostly. They let me be, and I let them be. That's the whole arrangement, and it works.
I get on with most of them. Easier when you're not in a hurry to be anywhere.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: Anything eaten sitting down, with time to finish it. Stew, mostly. Stew doesn't rush you.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.food.first/2: Bread, cheese, shade. Not complicated. The best things generally aren't.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: It's a long story and I tell it slowly, %1$s. Settle in — there's no short version worth having.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.life.first/2: Ordinary enough, and I've enjoyed most of it. That's more than plenty of people can say.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: A porch, a long afternoon, and nothing on the list. I'm told that isn't ambitious. I'm told a lot of things.
Enough put by that I never have to hurry again. That's the whole of it.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.fears.first/: Waking up one day in a hurry and never getting out of it. You see it happen to people, %1$s.
Being rushed through the good parts. That's my only real fear, and it's a serious one.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.fir: I like you, %1$s. No great speech about it — I just do, steadily, and that's the kind that lasts.
You're easy company. Coming from me, that's about the highest thing I say about anyone.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.pers: That's a question for a longer afternoon than this one, %1$s. Come back when we've got the time.
Not today. Nothing against you — I just get round to things when I get round to them.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.inti: That's deep, and I don't do deep quickly. Give it a season or two, %1$s.
You'll get there. Just not at this speed. Ask me again sometime.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/: Nothing worth carrying. Quiet week — and honestly, I don't chase the news down.
No news. It usually finds me a few days late anyway, and none the worse for it.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Very. You're the easiest thing in my life, %1$s, and I don't say that lightly.
Yes. Comfortably so. No part of this is hard work, and that's exactly how it should be.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.marri: %2$s and %3$s got married. Lovely, unhurried sort of day. Everyone stayed late, which is the sign of a good one.
Heard %2$s and %3$s wed. Took them long enough — and there's nothing wrong with that.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.divor: %2$s and %3$s have gone their separate ways. These things take the time they take. No sense hurrying grief.
%2$s and %3$s split up. Quietly, thankfully. Best way to do it.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.death: Sad news, %1$s — %2$s passed on. Sit with it a while. That's the only thing that helps, and it won't be hurried.
%2$s is gone. I've been taking that slowly. Some things you shouldn't rush past.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth: %2$s was born. Whole village slowed down to have a look. Nice, that — everyone stopping at once.
New one arrived: %2$s. They'll be running about before anyone's ready. They always are.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.arriv: %2$s moved in. No hurry to get acquainted — we've years for that. That's the good part of a small village.
We've got a %2$s now. Seem settled enough already. Good sign.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.depar: %2$s packed up and went. Took their time about it, mind — proper goodbyes all round. I appreciated that.
%2$s left for good. Shame. They were easy company, and there's not a surplus of that.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: Ran that past me a bit quick. Again?
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/1: Couldn't say. Doesn't trouble me much.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: Middle of something. It'll wait, but so will you.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.busy/2: Give me a minute. Or two.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: See you, %1$s. Don't hurry on my account.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/2: Off you go. Take it easy.
lazy.dialogue.chatmode.insult/1: Not rising to that. Too warm out.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough.em: It is. And you're not suggesting I do something about it, which is the kindest possible response.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.roug: The wood. Tuesday. ...Wednesday. Let's say Wednesday and both feel better about it.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.work.followu: ...It is. Everyone thinks I'm idle. I'm tired, which is a different thing entirely.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.fears.open.p: You'll stand with me. Then I'll get round to facing it. Eventually. But I will.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.hopes.respon: You waited. Nice pace, this. Nobody hurrying anybody. I could do a whole conversation like this.
lazy.dialogue.conversations.life.revisit: You asked about my life once. I've been meaning to finish the answer for days now.
